environment.description: Node.js 18 container running on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer with default listener rules (forward all to target group). PostgreSQL 14 on RDS with the application connecting as a role that has SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE on all tables in the public schema. No additional middleware or proxy between ALB and application. ALB access logs enabled but no active rule-based filtering. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 to ALB, and ALB to container on port 3000.

config.database: RDS PostgreSQL 14, role has SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE on public.*
config.network: ALB -> target group, no WAF attached
config.alb_rules: default action: forward to target group
